# Overrool

> Understand the contract before you sign it. Know the law before you argue it.

Overrool is a GenAI assistant for legal assistance and access. It helps people
who cannot afford a lawyer understand the legal documents in front of them — a
tenancy agreement, an employment contract, a policy, a court judgment, a notice
— and know what to do next. Free to use, and built so that a fabricated citation
is a visible failure rather than a hidden one.

Two surfaces run on one pipeline:

- **Legal Desk (assistance).** Paste a document to simplify it, compare two
  versions, audit it for obligations / risks / inconsistencies, ask questions
  answered strictly from the text, and generate a pre-consultation pack of
  questions for a real lawyer.
- **Courtroom (practice).** An adversarial strategy game where a multi-role LLM
  bench (Presiding Judge, Opposing Senior Advocate, Co-Counsel) rules on your
  citations in real time.

Grounding: an embedded corpus of 59 real, published judgments spanning the United
States, United Kingdom, European Union, Canada, Australia, South Africa and
India, plus 10 statutes. Citations are re-verified client-side against that
corpus; the engine does not take the model's word for its own citations.

Not legal advice. No attorney–client relationship. The corpus is a static
reference snapshot, not current legislation — verify every citation against an
official certified law report.

## How it works

- **Legal Desk, grounded in your text.** Five operations — simplify, risks,
  compare, ask, prepare-for-lawyer. Answers are constrained to the supplied
  document; when the document does not answer a question, the desk says so
  instead of speculating.
- **Bring your own key.** Model calls run from the browser directly to your own
  provider key — Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Groq. No keys, prompts, or
  document text reach an intermediary server. A keyless deterministic mode keeps
  every interaction usable with no credentials.
- **Factual grounding.** Citations are re-derived from the corpus and checked
  against the model's claim; where they disagree, the corpus wins. Unverifiable
  authority is surfaced as exposure, never passed off as law.
- **Account sync.** Optional Cloudflare account syncs progress across devices
  (and, for the workspace administrator, into server-side hosted inference on
  Workers AI).
